name: Green Day

whyMatters.en: East Bay pop-punk three that scaled Kerplunk DIY into Dookie (1994) mass: Basket Case power-chord hooks beside grunge; American Idiot (2004) later proved punk concept-album stadium scale.
whyMatters.zh: 东湾 pop-punk 三人组：把 Kerplunk DIY 扩成 Dookie（1994）大众——Basket Case power-chord 钩子与 grunge 并列；American Idiot（2004）后来证明朋克概念专集可达体育场体量。

lyricQuotes: Do you have the time / To listen to me whine
Don't want to be an American idiot

shortBio.en: Berkeley pop-punk three; Dookie Basket Case mass hit, American Idiot concept stadium return.
shortBio.zh: 伯克利 pop-punk 三人；Dookie Basket Case 大众热单，American Idiot 概念体育场回归。

body.en:
Formed 1987 in Berkeley/Rodeo (Sweet Children). Tré Cool replaces Al Sobrante 1990. Dookie (1994, Rob Cavallo) is the citation LP: Longview bass intro, Basket Case power-chord chorus, When I Come Around—East Bay punk into MTV/alt radio beside Nirvana.

American Idiot (2004) is the second hinge: political concept, Jesus of Suburbia suite, stadium punk production. 21st Century Breakdown adds Last Night on Earth ballad. Craft is three-chord clarity and Armstrong melody, not hardcore speed alone.
body.zh:
1987 年于伯克利/Rodeo 组建（Sweet Children）。Tré Cool 1990 年替换 Al Sobrante。Dookie（1994，Rob Cavallo）是引用 LP：Longview 贝斯 intro、Basket Case power-chord 副歌、When I Come Around——东湾朋克进 MTV/alt 电台，与 Nirvana 并列。

American Idiot（2004）是第二铰链：政治概念、Jesus of Suburbia 组曲、体育场朋克制作。21st Century Breakdown 加入 Last Night on Earth 谣曲。工艺是三和弦清晰与 Armstrong 旋律，非仅 hardcore 速度。

note.en: Dookie power-chord chorus; 1994 pop-punk mass breakthrough.
note.zh: Dookie power-chord 副歌；1994 pop-punk 大众突破。

note.en: Concept-album title charge; stadium punk political hook.
note.zh: 概念专集标题冲锋；体育场朋克政治钩子。

note.en: 21st Century Breakdown ballad; Armstrong melody over soft dynamic.
note.zh: 21st Century Breakdown 谣曲；Armstrong 旋律压软动态。

title.en: East Bay punk to mass alt radio
title.zh: 东湾朋克到大众 alt 电台

body.en:
Green Day keep Ramones-length songs and power-chord grids, then add Armstrong’s melodic chorus for 1994 radio.

Basket Case is the Dookie proof track. American Idiot later reloads the same trio as concept stadium punk.

Not grunge soft-loud; verse-chorus punk clarity.
body.zh:
Green Day 保持 Ramones 曲长与 power-chord 网格，再加 Armstrong 旋律副歌打 1994 电台。

Basket Case 是 Dookie 证明曲。American Idiot 后来把同一三人组重装成概念体育场朋克。

非 grunge soft-loud；主副歌朋克清晰。

title.zh: Armstrong / Dirnt / Tré Cool 三人

body.en:
Kiffmeyer exits 1990; Tré Cool locks the classic three. Jason White often adds live/rhythm guitar later without changing core writing names.

No classic fracture—same three credits from Dookie through American Idiot.

Peak citation: 1994 and 2004.
body.zh:
Kiffmeyer 1990 年离队；Tré Cool 钉住经典三人。Jason White 后来常加现场/节奏吉他，不改核心写作名。

无经典分裂——从 Dookie 到 American Idiot 仍是三人署名。

巅峰引用：1994 与 2004。

title.zh: Dookie 之后的 pop-punk 模板

body.en:
Blink-182, Fall Out Boy, and 2000s Warped-era acts cite Dookie chorus engineering. American Idiot shows punk concept can fill arenas.

Peer to Nirvana on 1994 alt radio with different gear: Marshall/power chords vs Seattle soft-loud.

Debt is melody + three-chord speed.
body.zh:
Blink-182、Fall Out Boy 与 2000 年代 Warped 期乐队引用 Dookie 副歌工程。American Idiot 证明朋克概念可填满 arenas。

1994 alt 电台与 Nirvana 同代，装备不同：Marshall/power chords vs 西雅图 soft-loud。

债务在旋律 + 三和弦速度。

interviewQuotes.text: Dookie was just our songs played louder. The radio made it a movement.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Billie Joe Armstrong

interviewQuotes.text: American Idiot had to be a story. Punk can hold a concept if the choruses still hit.
